# proxmox_node_ceph_osd_scrub (Resource)

Scrubs one OSD through `POST /nodes/{node}/ceph/osd/{osdid}/scrub`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_ceph_osd_scrub" "s" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  osdid    = 0
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `osdid` (Number)
- `triggers` (Map of String)

### Optional

- `deep` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `upid` (String)
